### Phase Q1: the HF quantizer under the quality harness — quant_lf re-screen, dead-zone and lambda sweeps, real-cost last-position truncation

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.quality-q1-quantizer/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

With the LF sections entropy-coded (Q0b) the ledger's own pointers become testable on the standing harness: (1) re-screen quant_lf 8, promoted in Phase 5G under the flat code's mispriced LF residuals (LF is still 23% of a 1 bpp stream); (2) sweep the dead-zone scale (EncodeRequest.dead_zone_scale) and lambda_scale (analytic 16/mean(step^2) x4 was never calibrated against a perceptual metric) on the ladder and the seven scenes; (3) price the trailing-position truncation in truncate_trailing at real token cost from the trained fast model instead of residual_bits/ZERO_TOKEN_BITS (7.1a's prescribed design). Each is a Contract B change if promoted: request-default flips with the old value reachable by flag, gated by the contract's quality-track bounds and the +15% cumulative speed budget (about 9 points spent by Q0b).
